title: The Fall of Lumerian
pages: For centuries, the Lumerian Kingdom stood as one of the great powers of Florian Land.
Its people lived beneath the protection of its walls, unaware of the ancient terror approaching them.
From the darkness came Vorlithra, the three-headed Soul Devourer. Its arrival marked the beginning of the War of Fallen Skies.
As the kingdom called its champions to war, Leonhard von Evermont rode toward the outer city.
